RED ROWBOAT AT THE WONKY DOCK: a cheerful red-painted rowboat tied to a slightly wonky plank dock on a small round lake, a brass lantern hung from a pole at its bow, a coil of rope on the boards, a tiny blue cabin with a crooked chimney among the pines behind

YELLOW SKIFF AT THE TILTING DOCK: a sunny yellow skiff resting against a tilting wooden dock on a calm forest lake, a tiny striped flag on a short mast, a wicker basket tucked under the bow seat, a ring of mossy posts poking from the water around it

GREEN CANOE AT THE PEBBLE DOCK: a leaf-green canoe nosed up to a low pebble-edged dock on a wide still lake, a tiny painted tin lantern clipped to its bow, a stack of orange life rings on the dock post, a ring of round-topped firs curving the shore behind

BLUE SKIFF AT THE CROOKED PIER: a cornflower-blue skiff tied to a gently crooked pier on a glassy mountain lake, a hand-painted anchor symbol on its bow, a coil of yellow rope looped over a tilted post, a cluster of round-topped hills rising softly behind the dock

ORANGE CANOE AT THE MUSHROOM-CAP DOCK: a bright orange canoe moored at a stumpy round-topped dock on a quiet oval lake, a tiny copper bell hung from a driftwood post, a pair of red paddles crossed and propped against the dock railing, a fringe of round berry bushes along the bank

STORYBOOK FISHING HARBOUR AT COBBLE COVE: a cluster of plump little boats in red, blue, and yellow tied at a cobbled quay, a row of crooked painted cottages stacked up the hill behind, a striped lighthouse at the headland, a fish-shaped weathervane spinning on the tallest gable

CROOKED HARBOUR OF TILTING MASTS: a tidy fishing harbour with four squat colourful boats at a curving stone quay, nets looped over iron hooks along the wall, a higgledy row of lime-washed cottages climbing the hill, a tiny bell tower with a copper dome at the very top

MUSTARD HARBOUR VILLAGE QUAY: a warm mustard-coloured quayside harbour with plump trawlers in coral and teal bobbing at timber fingers, a crooked row of crooked little cottages painted in sherbet shades along the waterfront, a round harbour clock on a striped post at the quay corner

PINK HARBOUR ON THE HEADLAND: a curving stone harbour cradling three chubby pink-and-white fishing boats, a winding cobbled lane climbing past crooked flower-box cottages to a striped lighthouse on the bluff, a carved wooden fish hanging above the harbour gate

LEANING RED-AND-WHITE LIGHTHOUSE: a short red-and-white striped lighthouse leaning ever so slightly on a round rock point, a keeper's cottage with a green door beside it, a little dory hauled up on the shingle, a curl of stone wall enclosing a tiny garden of round topiary balls

YELLOW-STRIPED LIGHTHOUSE ON THE ROCKS: a plump yellow-and-white striped lighthouse perched on a jumble of smooth grey rocks above the sea, a round window with a brass frame near its lamp room, a keeper's cottage with a red door and a striped awning tucked against its base

CROOKED BLUE LIGHTHOUSE POINT: a slightly crooked blue-painted lighthouse on a low grassy point, its lamp room ringed with tiny brass portholes, a whitewashed keeper's cottage with a heart-shaped window in its gable beside it, a short stone jetty curling into the cove below

SLEEPY FERRY AT THE RIVER LANDING: a wide, flat-decked ferry painted sage green with a broad red-and-white striped awning, moored at a timber landing stage on a slow river bend, a brass bell on a rope at the bow, a painted board

PUNT UNDER THE WILLOW LANDING: a slim wooden punt in faded sky-blue resting at a plank landing stage on a gentle river, a long striped pole propped along its side, a tiny bunting of triangle flags strung from the willow branches above the stage, a lantern on a post at the dock end

LANTERN LANDING ON THE RIVER BEND: a flat-bottomed river ferry in cream and cherry red tied at a timber landing stage on a winding river, a tall iron lantern post at the end of the stage, a carved wooden arrow pointing to the far bank, a rope-and-wood handrail looping along the dock

LONE CANOE ON THE MIST LAKE: a sky-blue canoe resting at the centre of a wide misty lake, a tiny paper lantern dangling from a short pole at its stern, a single red paddle laid across the gunwales, the far shore a soft smudge of round-topped trees in the distance

COPPER-TRIMMED CANOE ON OPEN WATER: a deep forest-green canoe floating on a broad open lake, a small copper weathervane shaped like a fish fixed to its bow post, a folded tartan blanket tucked under the front seat, the far mountains a gentle row of soft blue triangles on the horizon

STAR-FLAGGED CANOE ON THE LAKE: a cherry-red canoe adrift on a smooth pewter-grey lake, a tiny star-shaped flag on a slim bamboo mast at its centre, a round tin lunch pail secured to the middle thwart with a leather strap, a distant wooded island sitting low on the water ahead

TINY MARINA WITH STRIPED SAILS: a snug little marina with five small wooden sailboats in red, yellow, and blue at slim wooden finger docks, each sail a different cheerful stripe, a painted harbourmaster's hut with a round window at the dock head, a string of triangle pennants along the posts

TINY MARINA WITH ONE STRIPED-SAIL HERO: one small round-bellied wooden sailboat with a red-and-yellow striped sail at the near finger dock, its bow carved into a smiling fish, a harbourmaster hut with a round window at the dock head, three far-off boats as small shapes across the basin, a string of triangle pennants along the posts

LEMON-SAIL SLOOP AT A SNUG MARINA: a single plump sloop with a lemon-yellow sail moored at a neat wooden dock, a round-roofed dock office with a striped awning behind it, a painted wooden dolphin on the entrance post, a cluster of coloured buoys bobbing beside the hull, other boats tiny and far in the channel

BLUE-SAIL SLOOP IN THE INLET: one small sloop with a cobalt-blue sail tucked at a timber finger in a calm inlet, a squat harbourmaster booth in red-and-cream stripes at the dock root, a hanging basket of painted tin flowers on the nearest mooring post, two far sloops as small shapes near the inlet mouth

TEAL BARGE WITH FLOWER BOXES: a wide teal-painted canal barge with a row of red flower boxes along each side, a yellow stovepipe chimney with a spinning cowl on top, a striped canvas awning over the stern deck, moored at a mossy stone canal bank with iron mooring rings

THATCHED TROPICAL PIER: a palm-trunk pier extending over turquoise shallows to a small thatched roof hut at its end, the planks painted in alternating coral and cream, a string of round paper lanterns along the handrail, a carved wooden pineapple at the pier entrance

OUTRIGGER WITH A TINY SAIL: a slim wooden outrigger canoe with a small triangular orange-and-white sail, tied to a short palm-trunk dock over bright turquoise water, a carved wooden fish figure at its prow, a thatched shelter on stilts at the dock head with open lattice sides and a striped hammock inside
